proposition: What does a geometric-mean reporting comment require for comparison of individual monitoring-period values?
would_establish: Permit footnote *6 in documents/farmington/final_permit.txt ties TDS discharge reporting to geometric mean of weekly values.
Statement of basis in documents/farmington/statement_of_basis.txt describes TDS net-incremental increase enforcement as a 30-day average limit distinct from weekly geometric-mean discharge reporting.
Structured permit_limits rows show STATISTICAL_BASE_TYPE_CODE in {AVG, MAX, MIN} for all 40 geometric-mean-comment occurrences; none encode geometric mean as the structured comparison basis.
Non-TDS parameters (e.g., PARAMETER_CODE=00310 BOD) carry a DMR comment that explicitly names only TDS, indicating limit-set comment propagation rather than parameter-specific comparison semantics.
DMR measurements store one value per MONITORING_PERIOD_END_DATE (monthly) with ordinary numeric comparison fields, including for rows paired with geometric-mean comments.
would_refute: A uniform rule that every geometric-mean comment row requires computing a weekly geometric mean before any numeric limit comparison.
Treating the TDS-specific comment as altering comparison semantics for non-TDS parameters such as BOD, TSS, pH, or E. coli.
Inferring from structured fields alone that geometric mean replaces AVG/MAX/MIN as the enforcement comparison statistic for TDS net-increase numeric limits.
insufficient_alone: PRIOR_PACKET.json (bounded prior retrieval, not authoritative disposition)
documents/aztec/final_permit.txt and documents/gcc/final_permit.txt (unrelated geometric-mean mentions for other facilities/parameters)
documents/farmington/part_iv.txt (fecal coliform geometric mean, not this DMR_COMMENT_TEXT trigger)
Structured STATISTICAL_BASE_TYPE_CODE values without permit narrative (no codebook maps AVG to geometric mean)
dmr_measurements.csv alone (cannot verify whether monthly values are pre-aggregated weekly geometric means; no weekly sub-period samples present)
